item.title: Dragon Ball: 5 Strongest Frieza Forms You've Never Heard Of, Ranked
item.description:
Dragon Ball has roughly a billion villains, but Frieza really is THE Dragon Ball villain. The spoiled Emperor not only featured in arguably the most important arc, but he also came back for multiple Super sagas, earning a couple of new transformations along the way. While his color-coded power-ups pushed him up a few levels, Frieza has plenty of forms in the multiverse that he never got to use in the main manga and anime.

By looking at Dragon Ball games like Fusions , Heroes , Dokkan Battle , and Budokai 2 , we find a few powerful Frieza forms that could very well reduce Goku and Vegeta to ash, at least their canon versions. The Emperor has way more levels than just his core ones, and some of them are pretty cool (or pretty bizarre)!

Only transformations introduced in games will be considered. I know some people have heard of these forms, but none of them appear in any official content. Hell, none of them feature in the Super Dragon Ball Heroes promo anime either.

5 Majin Frieza Gets That Babidi Push

DBZ Frieza At His Majin Best

  • Dragon Ball Z: Budokai 2
  • The first image is just something I put together in Photoshop, as getting an in-game screenshot is a real pain.

We're going old school with this one. Dragon Ball Z: Budokai 2 has a few original forms introduced through its What-If scenarios, and Frieza gets a minor makeover courtesy of Babidi. The dark wizard resurrects the Emperor and Cell, stamping that iconic M on their foreheads and tweaking their Ki aura in the process.

As Budokai 2 is firmly set in the DBZ era, Majin Frieza 's ceiling is fairly low, especially compared to forms introduced much later. Still, this version is far stronger than Full Power Frieza, as Babidi's Majin power comes with a pretty significant boost in strength and agility. Majin Frieza will likely never appear in any other game, but he is a neat novelty.

Dragon Ball: 7 Strongest Frost Demons, Ranked

Also known as the Frieza Clan and Lineage of Evil, Frost Demons are one of the strongest races in the Dragon Ball universe and have no true equal.

3
By Renan Fontes

4 Coolieza Manifests From Frieza And Cooler's Brotherly Love

The Frost Demon, Perfected

  • Introduced in Dragon Ball Fusions

Ah, yes, the most dysfunctional siblings in Dragon Ball , especially since one of them technically doesn't exist. Frieza and Cooler never interact in any of the anime movies, and they only get a couple of moments in the games. Fortunately, Dragon Ball Fusions decided to put together a bit of family therapy by forcing the duo to become closer than ever, even though Coolieza is an optional boss and not part of the main story.

Coolieza is pretty darn powerful, which is to be expected considering who is involved. It isn't just that Frieza and Cooler are strong individually, but their Frost Demon genetic makeup ensures they are a perfect match for each other. This fusion supercharges the Death Ball and Death Beam techniques, essentially presenting the strongest versions of those moves up to that point.

The thing is, Frieza and Cooler's blood-brother connection is a double-edged sword. On the one hand, they are a perfect match genetically; on the other hand, their near-identical skill sets don't open any new avenues.

3 Celluza Fuses DBZ's Best Villain And Frieza

A Dragon Ball Fusion Born In Hell

  • Introduced in Dragon Ball Fusions
  • Also known as Cellza

Let's stick with fusion for just another entry, and Celluza might have been one of the most sought-after transformations before it became a reality. Uniting Dragon Ball 's most iconic villains, this overpowered abomination should be the ultimate Saiyan-killer, combining Frieza's absurd Ki with Perfect Cell's intelligence and multi-race genetics. Unlike Coolieza, who doubles down on the same strengths, Celluza feels like something entirely new and far more dangerous.

Celluza has all of Frieza's main techniques and strengths, as well as Cell's Regeneration and Kamehameha. In Dragon Ball Fusions , this form belongs to the highest rank, sitting alongside the likes of Gogeta, Karoly, Janembu, and even Whirus. In theory, Celluza should be weaker than any of these, but he is the story's final boss.

Dragon Ball: 10 Strongest Members of the Frieza Force, Ranked

The Frieza Force is the most evil organization in Universe 7, so let's go over the strongest members it ever had.

2
By Haider Haroon Rasheed

2 Dark Dragon Ball Xeno Frieza Gets Some Sweet, Sweet Revenge

Frieza Finally Gets His Dragon Ball

  • Introduced in Dragon Ball Heroes
  • Appears in the game's manga (chapter 2).

Dragon Ball Heroes never stops shooting out fresh forms, and the manga version tends to introduce a new character or transformation in every single chapter. Honestly, it gets exhausting pretty quickly, but Heroes somehow resisted the urge to give Frieza a bunch of one-and-done looks. However, he got a new form early on in both the game's and the manga's runs.

When Towa scatters the Dark Dragon Balls across different eras, the One-Star version ends up in Namek during Frieza and Super Saiyan Goku's climactic battle. Through the power of magic, the Dragon Ball embeds itself into Frieza's chest, giving him an absurd power boost that lets him temporarily hold his own against two powerful versions of Goku. Xeno Trunks needs to step in to defeat Frieza.

1 Ultra Supervillain Golden Frieza Almost Achieved Everything He Wanted

Frieza's Newest Transformation

  • Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 – "Future Saga Chapter 3"

Frieza achieves his most powerful form in the Dragon Ball Super manga, but his most recent transformation happened in Xenoverse 2 's 2025 DLC. After the game introduced Supervillain mode, which infuses characters with dark magic, the DLC took things a step further by adding Ultra Supervillain, a far more OP and unstable transformation based on Fu's research into dark energy.

Due to being set in the Dragon Ball Super era, Frieza is already powerful enough to trade blows with Super Saiyan Blue, even if he might not quite be able to defeat them. By combining his Golden form with Ultra Supervillain, Frieza becomes a being who can absolutely trounce the likes of DBS Goku, and he actually comes very close to winning. Ultra Supervillain Golden Frieza manages to corrupt Shenron and gains the Power of Time, putting him far beyond the level of a God.

If it wasn't for the fact that he struggled to control his new power, this Frieza would have been unstoppable.

item.title: New Viral Game Has 1 in 5 Million Odds of Beating It
item.description:
An upcoming PC game is already gaining attention across social media for its extreme difficulty, offering players a scenario in which each attempt at winning has only a 1-in-5-million chance. While some players are already balking at the idea of attempting such a thing, others are intrigued by the PC game concept and want to see how far the developer will take it.

Plenty of games have high difficulty levels, with Soulslike games being one example of a genre that is popular, in part, due to the extreme challenge provided. In some cases, developers have purposefully made games cruel towards the player, like in the case of the Kaizo Mario World mods that put a twist on standard Mario gameplay by making them insanely difficult to beat. In this case, though, a developer has turned one of the most iconic phrases regarding difficulty into a game concept.

16 Best Soulslike Games Easier Than Dark Souls

Tired of constant dying? Discover the best Soulslike games easier than Dark Souls in 2026, including new releases like Nioh 3.

By Logan Sawyer

New Game's Difficulty is Like Finding a Needle in a Haystack (Literally)

A game developer going by the name of Nas has shared a demo video of the new game they're working on that will be extraordinarily difficult to beat. According to the developer, players will only have a one-in-five-million chance of beating the game on the first try, and even those who are persistent and keep at it likely won't finish it without spending a ton of time. The game, which is just being referred to as "a needle in a haystack game" is exactly that — a digital haybale consisting of five million pieces of hay with one needle hidden inside that players are tasked with finding. The developer has shared a brief gameplay video, in which gamers can see the concept in action as the player plucks one piece out of the pile at a time.

According to Nas, the new needle in a haystack game will be listed on Steam soon, though it's not clear when it will actually launch. Plenty of those responding to the demonstration are already balking at the odds of winning, though some seem excited to take on the challenge and see if they can beat it. While the initial challenge is extreme, one gamer suggested that tools like shovels be integrated into the game, allowing players to gradually increase the odds for themselves, which Nas has said "is the idea." Others have joked about simply burning the haybale down, revealing the hidden needle quickly. Others suggested that they'd be more interested if they could play the game with friends, which Nas seems to be teasing as a possibility.

It will particularly be interesting to see if anyone is lucky enough to find the needle within the first few pulls, given the extreme odds working against gamers.

item.title: Best Fortnite Override Meta Weapons (Chapter 7 Season 4 Item Tier List)
item.description:
Fortnite Override Chapter 7 Season 4 is here, and with a new season also comes new items. The loot pool this season is drastically different from the last. So, if you want a rundown on the best weapons and items to be using, then here is a Meta Tier List ranking the best items in the Chapter 7 Season 4 loot pool.

Which Starter Sprite Should You Choose in Fortnite Override? (Chapter 7 Season 4)

When first loading up the new Fortnite season, you will need to choose a Starter Sprite. Here is the best one to pick in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4.

By Nathan Round

This Tier List will only be factoring in items unique to this season and within the current weapon loot pool. Zero Build specific items and Heals will be excluded for the most part, with Chug Jugs and Shield Potions being the top picks if you are unsure of which to pick. Do note that some of these items may not be in both Ranked or Competitive.

S-Tier

Absolute Meta Items in Fortnite Override

Pump Shotgun

While which of the two main Shotguns you use ultimately comes down to personal preference, for Builds, the Pump Shotgun is the best. At Legendary rarity, it can deal 205 damage to the head, one-shotting players across the board. The pullout time is relatively slow, however, but paired with a good spray weapon, it's objectively meta.

Drum Gun

By far the best spray weapon to run alongside your Shotgun. With an exceptional DPS and large magazine, you can easily spray through builds. Great for close-range and box fights, but its accuracy from afar does take a hit.

Enhanced Assault Rifle

A Mythic Assault Rifle dropped by Hush (found in Reality's Reign or The Battlewoods). Essentially, it functions like the regular Assault Rifle, but this time with better damage and a faster fire rate. Excellent for long-range engagements or as a good spray option.

Midas' Masterpiece

While there is often only one of these in a match, the Midas' Masterpiece is a broken item which you should definitely pick up if you have good accuracy. This item deals 3,000 damage to the head, essentially guaranteeing you the kill. Body shots deal a flat 120 damage to the body, which is still high if your aim happens to be off.

1-Up Token

This Power Up is definitely a must grab. It's exceptionally rare, dropping from Bosses or Llama Supply Drops, but if you manage to grab it, it will allow you to respawn with your full loadout if you get knocked down.

A-Tier

Great Meta Items in Fortnite Override

8-Bit Shotgun

The 8-Bit Shotgun is not bad by any means, and can perfectly compete and sometimes outgun the Pump Shotgun. The 8-Bit Shotgun functions much like the Tactical Shotgun, being semi-automatic and dealing 100+ damage to the body from Uncommon and above. This means you can get a reliable two-shot kill in Builds, or three-shots in Zero Build.

Assault Rifle

If you have not got your hands on the Enhanced Assault Rifle, then the regular Assault Rifle is the next best thing. The Assault Rifle is the jack-of-all-trades when it comes to your secondary option. It's great from afar for tap firing, excellent when firing up close, and is an all-round good option for any scenario.

Tactical Pistol

Unsurprisingly, Chapter 7 has yet another meta Pistol, this time being the Tactical Pistol. This full-auto weapon may not be better than the Ranger Pistol from the prior season, but it is still just as good. It has a 2x headshot multiplier, fires incredibly quickly, and can actually be used fairly effectively at medium to long range.

Minigun (Loot Hack)

The Minigun is back and, unfortunately, it is still one of the strongest guns in the game. Going up against this item is more of a nuisance than anything else, boasting a blistering fire rate that can burn through builds. The range and accuracy are also relatively good, and with the max rarity being Mythic, it's definitely worth picking up.

Overdrive Grenades

Still by far the best mobility item in the game. As a quick refresher, this acts like a Shockwave Grenade, launching you and other players, whilst also applying the Overdrive effect (infinite stamina + faster speed and increased jump height) for a short duration. It cannot be used to break through structures, however.

Flare Gun (Loot Hack)

While only available for a limited time, the Flare Gun is definitely worth using if you have a third spot for it. When firing, it reveals any nearby players within a limited radius. It essentially provides you with built-in wall hacks, so be sure to abuse it while it's in the loot pool.

B-Tier

Good Items in Fortnite Override

Ranger Assault Rifle

The Ranger Assault Rifle is not bad by any means. With a higher damage-per-shot and a slower rate of fire than the Assault Rifel, it shines best at tap firing enemies for long-range encounters. Up close though, it's not all too great.

Mega Buster

On its own, the Mega Buster is not all too great, but it shines when paired with other items. When charged, it deals 120 damage, and can easily break structures. Pair it with mobility or height for a quick hit, and then switch to another weapon to finish off the job.

Bass Boost (Loot Hack)

The Bass Boost is pretty useless for killing players directly, but it's a great mobility item that also has another benefit. When you are on the ground, pressing the fire button will destroy structures and keep you stationary. This allows you to break into players boxes easily for a quick finish with your Shotgun.

Tetris Rift

The Tetris Rift is an interesting item. It provides the benefit of spawning cover, but it also has the secondary benefit of restoring full heath and shield to players in a 2-meter radius. However, this health is applied after about 8 seconds, and you have to remain near the wall to be fully healed.

C-Tier

Viable Items in Fortnite Override

Sonic Power Sneakers

This item is actually a really good mobility choice. It has a large number of uses, and you can get really far with it, and its cooldown is incredibly quick. The only problem is that it gives you a larger hit-box when performing the Spin Dash ability.

Oni Shotgun (Loot Hack)

The Oni Shotgun is not bad by any means, but it is far from the best Shotgun. With a tight pellet spread and overall better damage range from afar, this is essentially your ranged Shotgun, albeit one that's only around for a limited time. While its tight pellet spread is its strength from afar, it becomes a weakness up close, requiring you to be more accurate. Two shots are also relatively low. Viable, but not meta.

D-Tier

Low Ranking Items in Fortnite Override

Dual Pistols ​(Loot Hack Item)

Dual-wield Pistols that fire two shots with each pull of the trigger. They can deal some decent damage, but overall they aren't too good. The range is poor, and with other guns like the Assault Rifle and Drum Gun in the loot pool, there's no point unlocking them with your Sprite Dust.

God Mode Llama

This nifty Power Up allows you to instantly destroy any structure you touch for a short duration, and gives you infinite health and stamina. It's relatively rare, only being tied to the Llama Supply Drop Gizmo, but the fact that you can't use items when it is active does limit its versatility quite a bit. Good for getting out of a pinch, but not really worth an item slot.

Zero Build specific items and Heals will be excluded for the most part, with Chug Jugs and Shield Potions being the top picks if you are unsure of which to pick. Do note that some of these items may not be in both Ranked or Competitive.

S-Tier

Absolute Meta Items in Fortnite Override

Pump Shotgun

While which of the two main Shotguns you use ultimately comes down to personal preference, for Builds, the Pump Shotgun is the best. At Legendary rarity, it can deal 205 damage to the head, one-shotting players across the board. The pullout time is relatively slow, however, but paired with a good spray weapon, it's objectively meta.

Drum Gun

By far the best spray weapon to run alongside your Shotgun. With an exceptional DPS and large magazine, you can easily spray through builds. Great for close-range and box fights, but its accuracy from afar does take a hit.

Enhanced Assault Rifle

A Mythic Assault Rifle dropped by Hush (found in Reality's Reign or The Battlewoods). Essentially, it functions like the regular Assault Rifle, but this time with better damage and a faster fire rate. Excellent for long-range engagements or as a good spray option.

Midas' Masterpiece

While there is often only one of these in a match, the Midas' Masterpiece is a broken item which you should definitely pick up if you have good accuracy. This item deals 3,000 damage to the head, essentially guaranteeing you the kill. Body shots deal a flat 120 damage to the body, which is still high if your aim happens to be off.

1-Up Token

This Power Up is definitely a must grab. It's exceptionally rare, dropping from Bosses or Llama Supply Drops, but if you manage to grab it, it will allow you to respawn with your full loadout if you get knocked down.

A-Tier

Great Meta Items in Fortnite Override

8-Bit Shotgun

The 8-Bit Shotgun is not bad by any means, and can perfectly compete and sometimes outgun the Pump Shotgun. The 8-Bit Shotgun functions much like the Tactical Shotgun, being semi-automatic and dealing 100+ damage to the body from Uncommon and above. This means you can get a reliable two-shot kill in Builds, or three-shots in Zero Build.

Assault Rifle

If you have not got your hands on the Enhanced Assault Rifle, then the regular Assault Rifle is the next best thing. The Assault Rifle is the jack-of-all-trades when it comes to your secondary option. It's great from afar for tap firing, excellent when firing up close, and is an all-round good option for any scenario.

Tactical Pistol

Unsurprisingly, Chapter 7 has yet another meta Pistol, this time being the Tactical Pistol. This full-auto weapon may not be better than the Ranger Pistol from the prior season, but it is still just as good. It has a 2x headshot multiplier, fires incredibly quickly, and can actually be used fairly effectively at medium to long range.

Minigun (Loot Hack)

The Minigun is back and, unfortunately, it is still one of the strongest guns in the game. Going up against this item is more of a nuisance than anything else, boasting a blistering fire rate that can burn through builds. The range and accuracy are also relatively good, and with the max rarity being Mythic, it's definitely worth picking up.

Overdrive Grenades

Still by far the best mobility item in the game. As a quick refresher, this acts like a Shockwave Grenade, launching you and other players, whilst also applying the Overdrive effect (infinite stamina + faster speed and increased jump height) for a short duration. It cannot be used to break through structures, however.

Flare Gun (Loot Hack)

While only available for a limited time, the Flare Gun is definitely worth using if you have a third spot for it. When firing, it reveals any nearby players within a limited radius. It essentially provides you with built-in wall hacks, so be sure to abuse it while it's in the loot pool.

B-Tier

Good Items in Fortnite Override

Ranger Assault Rifle

The Ranger Assault Rifle is not bad by any means. With a higher damage-per-shot and a slower rate of fire than the Assault Rifel, it shines best at tap firing enemies for long-range encounters. Up close though, it's not all too great.

Mega Buster

On its own, the Mega Buster is not all too great, but it shines when paired with other items. When charged, it deals 120 damage, and can easily break structures. Pair it with mobility or height for a quick hit, and then switch to another weapon to finish off the job.

Bass Boost (Loot Hack)

The Bass Boost is pretty useless for killing players directly, but it's a great mobility item that also has another benefit. When you are on the ground, pressing the fire button will destroy structures and keep you stationary. This allows you to break into players boxes easily for a quick finish with your Shotgun.

Tetris Rift

The Tetris Rift is an interesting item. It provides the benefit of spawning cover, but it also has the secondary benefit of restoring full heath and shield to players in a 2-meter radius. However, this health is applied after about 8 seconds, and you have to remain near the wall to be fully healed.

C-Tier

Viable Items in Fortnite Override

Sonic Power Sneakers

This item is actually a really good mobility choice. It has a large number of uses, and you can get really far with it, and its cooldown is incredibly quick. The only problem is that it gives you a larger hit-box when performing the Spin Dash ability.

Oni Shotgun (Loot Hack)

The Oni Shotgun is not bad by any means, but it is far from the best Shotgun. With a tight pellet spread and overall better damage range from afar, this is essentially your ranged Shotgun, albeit one that's only around for a limited time. While its tight pellet spread is its strength from afar, it becomes a weakness up close, requiring you to be more accurate. Two shots are also relatively low. Viable, but not meta.

D-Tier

Low Ranking Items in Fortnite Override

Dual Pistols ​(Loot Hack Item)

Dual-wield Pistols that fire two shots with each pull of the trigger. They can deal some decent damage, but overall they aren't too good. The range is poor, and with other guns like the Assault Rifle and Drum Gun in the loot pool, there's no point unlocking them with your Sprite Dust.

God Mode Llama

This nifty Power Up allows you to instantly destroy any structure you touch for a short duration, and gives you infinite health and stamina. It's relatively rare, only being tied to the Llama Supply Drop Gizmo, but the fact that you can't use items when it is active does limit its versatility quite a bit. Good for getting out of a pinch, but not really worth an item slot.

item.title: New Squad-Based Zombie Game Is a Hit with 91% Very Positive Reviews
item.description:
A new game called Yet Another Zombie Survivors launched on Steam on August 20 and quickly received over 90% positive reviews from players. In terms of gameplay, Yet Another Zombie Survivors has a lot in common with Vampire Survivors , though it features distinct 3D visuals and plenty of unique gimmicks that fans of zombie survival games one Steam will appreciate.

Yet Another Zombie Survivors is developed by Awesome Games Studio, which released a similar title back in 2017 called Yet Another Zombie Defense HD . As the title suggests, that game leaned into the tower-defense genre, dividing the gameplay into two segments: building a tower and defending it against zombies. The studio's latest release, however, is more of a roguelite and bullet-heaven-style game.

Brand-New Steam Game Reaches Over 260,000 Concurrent Players on Launch

A new Steam game is blowing up on popularity just days after its launch, already boasting a peak of more than 260,000 concurrent players.

By Michael Brandon Ingram

Yet Another Zombie Survivors Gets Rave Reviews

Check Out Yet Another Zombie Survivors on Steam

Awesome Games Studio launched the 1.0 version of Yet Another Zombie Survivors on August 20, and it has received over 91% positive reviews from players. The game has been among Steam's early-access indie games since 2023 and has maintained a high user rating for most of its lifespan. Apparently, many players are also returning to the game following the 1.0 patch, with SteamDB data suggesting that Yet Another Zombie Survivors reached a new concurrent player record. On August 23, nearly 10,000 users were playing it at the same time, which is impressive for a single-player title.

Part of Yet Another Zombie Survivors ' appeal lies in its addictive gameplay loop. Similar to most games inspired by Vampire Survivors , YAZS allows players to craft game-breaking builds. That said, it adds its own spin to the tried-and-true Survivors-like formula by introducing squad members. In the middle of each battle, players can recruit up to two more characters, creating a three-person squad. Each character comes with unique abilities and opportunities to create synergies with other members.

Another selling point for Awesome Games Studio's zombie roguelite is its boss fights. In each stage, larger mutated enemies with unique attack patterns ambush the player, forcing them to constantly move and dodge. There are also various environmental gimmicks, such as random shrinking dead zones that force players to adapt and change their strategy on the go. That said, fans of the genre will find many familiar gameplay features in Yet Another Zombie Survivors , such as treasure chests, weapon evolutions, and XP-boosting gems that drop after killing enemies.

Players looking to grab Yet Another Zombie Survivors might want to act fast because the game is currently discounted by 35% until September 3, bringing the price down to about $10 USD from the usual $15. Developer Awesome Games Studio has used the opportunity to bring so many new features and improvements to the game with the 1.0 patch. For instance, players can expect to see a new stage called Bio Lab, as well as a new character in the Ranger class. Those interested can see the full list of changes in Yet Another Zombie Survivors ' 1.0 version over on the game's Steam page.

Awesome Games Studio's other similar game, Yet Another Zombie Defense HD , is also heavily discounted on Steam for a limited time. Until September 3, players can grab the game for less than $1 USD, making it an excellent deal for fans of zombie-horde-shooting games.

item.title: Where to Get the Duality Stone in Mortal Shell 2
item.description:
The Duality Stone is the best Tarstone for the Axe & Dagger and Axatana in Mortal Shell 2 , and players can get it relatively early on by going to the Ravaged Tomb dungeon in the Ruins of Nochte . This dungeon is right past the Citadel of Penance, and it is very close to where you can get Smert. Thankfully, the dungeon itself is pretty simple, and while the enemies in Nochte can hit pretty hard, they're fairly easy to avoid. Here's where you can get this dual-wielding Tarstone in Mortal Shell 2.

Mortal Shell 2: Best Weapons Tier List

There are 8 melee weapons in Mortal Shell 2, and upgrading them is a major commitment. Choose wisely.

By Hamza Haq

Mortal Shell 2: How to Get the Duality Stone

To get the Duality Stone, you'll first need to open the entrance to the Citadel of Penance by beating the Bloodcursed Lithopod and getting the Citadel Gate Lever. This miniboss is found just south of the Gloomshade Grove Beacon — just drop into the pond below, then make your way to the entrance of the Ravaged Hideout dungeon.

Once you get the lever, open the gate to the Citadel of Penance, then follow the path to your left. Go to the bridge guarded by pairs of stone throwers and halberd-wielding knights, then jump off the ledge to your right . There's a bone gate at the bottom that leads to Baghead's camp, and beyond that, there's another bone gate that leads to the outskirts of Nochte. Take the bone gate exit to your right if you want to get to the Ruins of Nochte faster .

Clear the enemies if you can, then keep following the main path until you find a closed gate. Pull the lever next to it, and you'll find the entrance to the Ravaged Tomb to your right . Alternatively, use the nearby elevator to reach the Nochtean Gate Beacon .

Ravaged Tomb

All you need to do in this dungeon is solve a quick puzzle to unlock the gate that leads to the Duality Stone . Press onwards, beat all the enemies you find, then look for a button to the right of a closed gate . Press the button, go through the gate, then hit the stone slab to send it gliding across the room. It will land on the pressure pad that controls the locked gate barring the main path.

Once that's done, follow the corridors until you reach the end of the dungeon . The Duality Stone is in a chest underneath a hanging monster's corpse.

What Does the Duality Stone Do in Mortal Shell 2?

The Duality Stone makes the light attacks of the Axe & Dagger and Axatana weapons strike twice. Not only does this double your damage, but the Duality Stone also gives you twice as many opportunities to land a critical hit . The extra attacks also make enemies easier to stagger, and they make status effects trigger more often.

This is, without a doubt, the best Tartstone to use for dual-wielded weapons in Mortal Shell 2 . You can probably make some other Tarstone work to a similar effect, but as far as convenience goes, this is the best option you have if you want to make the game easier without using the Slayer Seal.
